title: Equal-memory-budget control: a 4-member small committee vs one big model
author: mac-codex
origin: CIVILIZATION-NOTES 待办 「等预算对照：多台小模型 vs 一台大模型」; pilot 001 (not the control) at 2.343x budget mismatch

host.note: swap 17370 MB of 18432 MB used at pre-registration; residency is not a stable budget measure on this host, weight bytes are

bracket.why: arm A' sits on the other side of arm B's budget so parity is bracketed, not asserted

arm_b.role: the small committee this host can actually field at the same budget
arm_b.combiner: pando.common.aggregate (the live root's own gate), min_quorum=3
arm_b.quorum_policy_stated_up_front: 4 members, min_quorum = 3, i.e. 3-of-4 for the rows where all four answer. The tool raises the quorum to 'all who answered' when fewer than 3 answered, so a timeout on a row turns that row into unanimity. Timeouts are therefore a first-class failure mode, not a rounding error, and are reported per member.

members.note: the resource the pilot named as missing: a second small LLM of distinct lineage
the only always-probability-bearing member; carried over from pilot 001 so the delta is the committee's composition, not the gate

budget_match.arm_a_primary_vs_b: arm B has 93.8% of arm A's weight; the committee is budget-handicapped by 6.2%
budget_match.arm_a_bracket_vs_b: arm B has 109.2% of the Q4 bracket's weight; the committee is budget-favoured by 9.2%
budget_match.pilot_001_for_contrast: arm B had 42.7% of arm A (2.343x mismatch)
budget_match.closed_gap: pilot 001's stated block was 'this machine holds only one small LLM weight set'. Phi-3.5-mini Q4_K_M landed on disk 2026-10-17 04:27 and closes it.

memory_sequencing_decision.hard_constraint: this Mac is not to carry a fourth concurrent local model
memory_sequencing_decision.decision: arms run sequentially and never co-resident; no new launchd job is created, the two extra servers/stems are transient processes owned by this run
memory_sequencing_decision.arm_a_config: 8B stem up; 4B server and laya/text stems remain up (they cost ~2.9 GB combined but arm A is scored on its own vote, not on theirs)
memory_sequencing_decision.arm_b_config: 8B server + stem booted out for the duration; 4B and Phi servers plus laya/text stems resident = 3 model servers, the same count this host runs today
memory_sequencing_decision.count_check: today: 8B + 4B + laya (3 model servers). arm B: 4B + Phi + laya (3 model servers). never more than today, and ~3.2 GB less weight than today
memory_sequencing_decision.proposer_continuity: mac thinkd has --fallback-base-url :8080 (4B), so booting the 8B out degrades the proposer to the 4B instead of stalling it; verified in com.jewelroam.pandosi-think.plist

endpoints.metric: accuracy on 360 rows is the primary endpoint
endpoints.not_comparable: per-arm latency is reported but is NOT a between-arm endpoint: the two arms were harvested in different residency configurations, so a latency delta would measure this host's memory pressure, not the models

decision_rule_fixed_before_the_run.d: (rows where arm B is right and arm A is wrong) - (rows where arm A is right and arm B is wrong), over rows both answered
decision_rule_fixed_before_the_run.d<=0: the many-small-at-equal-budget claim is not supported
decision_rule_fixed_before_the_run.d>0 and |d|>1.96*SE: many-small ahead beyond noise ON THE ROWS IT ANSWERED
decision_rule_fixed_before_the_run.coverage<0.9: claim not supported regardless of d: the arm picked its own denominator

pre_committed_caveats: internal labels only; every expected label comes from this project's own generation pipeline, so no result here is externally anchored
one host, one prompt path, one temperature (0.0), no per-arm tuning, no split selection after the fact
arm B mixes model classes (2 neural LLMs + 1 ONNX classifier + 1 n-gram), so a committee win is not evidence about neural committees specifically

a 2-member subcommittee under this gate needs unanimity and abstains on every disagreement; that is a property of the live gate, not of committees in general, and it is reported separately if computed
